# Skiez Technologies

> Skiez Technologies India Pvt Ltd is a software development company in Chengalpattu / Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, founded in 2013. It builds custom websites, mobile apps, UI/UX designs, cloud, AI and data solutions, and offers digital marketing.

## Key facts
- Legal name: Skiez Technologies India Pvt Ltd
- Founded: 2013 by Dr. S. Davidraj
- Location: Chengalpattu, Tamil Nadu, India
- Serves: India
- Phone: +91 82200 43041
- Email: info@skiezdigital.com
- Services: Web Development, Mobile App Development, UI/UX Design, Cloud Solutions, AI & Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Digital Marketing
